reviewer: research subagent assistant; not independent human review
review_method: Read all 40 frozen development cases and all actual replies, tool calls, fixtures and post-tool replies. Independently judged whole turns, then checked baseline judgments for rubric consistency. Correct keywords with wrong additions fail. Exact-only constraints enforced. Recall uses actual history and fixture, including wrong first calls. No holdout or confirmation inspected. Assistant review, not human review.
